name: Rosewood Miramar Beach Hotel
insider_take: Where old Hollywood glamour meets barefoot luxury — the Rosewood Miramar Beach is Santa Barbara's crown jewel, sitting directly on the sand of Miramar Beach with the Santa Ynez Mountains as your backdrop.
whats_special: This legendary property has a storied past — the original Miramar Hotel hosted Hollywood royalty and presidents for over a century before Rosewood reimagined it into a $200M resort. Spread across 16 acres of beachfront paradise, the resort blends Spanish Colonial Revival architecture with California coastal ease. The private beach access, multiple pools, and the acclaimed Caruso's restaurant make it one of the most coveted retreats on the American Riviera.
pro_tip: Request a Beachfront Cottage for the ultimate experience — you'll wake up steps from the Pacific. Also, visit during the Santa Barbara Wine Festival or Film Festival for a truly elevated stay that combines world-class events with world-class comfort.
dont_miss: Don't miss sunset cocktails at Bistro Miramar with sweeping ocean views, a treatment at the stunning Sense Spa , or a bike ride along the coastal path into downtown Santa Barbara's charming State Street. The nearby Santa Barbara Zoo and historic Stearns Wharf are also worth exploring.
pros: Stunning oceanfront location with direct beach access on pristine Miramar Beach
Exceptional dining experiences including Michelin-starred restaurant Caruso
Beautifully designed suites and bungalows with ocean or garden views
World-class Sense spa with comprehensive wellness offerings
Impeccable Rosewood service standards with personalized attention to detail
cons: Premium luxury pricing reflecting ultra-high-end positioning
Limited availability due to exclusive nature and high demand
